scope: Complete RNC1-RNC16 at their exact named classical foundations and the literal original CNR3 contract. No all-rank CountK/CountQ or OneChar theorem is inferred.

findings.detail: Directly checked BLGGT Theorem2.1.1, Section2.1, l=p II TheoremA/1.1/Corollary1.2 and Shin regularity, and JL Proposition10.9. General RA polarized existence precedes identification of the actual highest weight; full coefficient-prime compatibility is used after the two displayed weights meet Shin regularity. No Iwahori or large-prime condition is added, and ell=3 is retained.

Adelization and nebentype gluing, Fourier-coefficient Hecke relations, the |det|^(1/2) twist, geometric Frobenius q-scaling and the two precise highest weights agree. De Rham exactness is used only after identifying the whole representation. The full original closures and fixed iota are retained.

The original no-cyclotomic-ratio/potential-crystallinity disjunction eliminates monodromy at coefficient primes outside M. Finite inertia characters have conductor at most v(M), and nilpotent loss is at most n-1. Generic newvectors therefore give auxiliary levels M^5/M^3 without changing original Galois levels.

A fixed level-three torsion-free arithmetic CW model, explicit polynomial highest-weight ranks and finite covers give the exponents18/4 and final90/12. Projective O_F lattices admit integral Z bases for the mod3 argument. Full cusp labels, not one-place eigenvalues, are retained. The Hecke formula uses only q^{j(j-1)/2}, so Aut(C) conjugation has no square-root ambiguity.

Compact-image lattices give units away from p; crystalline Newton/Hodge bounds give both integral endpoints at p. RNC9 and RNC10 give exactly the geometric trace of the rank-three representation and of the restricted two-by-two block plus1. Equal labels imply isomorphism, including reducible restrictions, and the disjoint-union classifier preserves the original disjunction.

Every q^e(t-Eis) is nonzero integral. The complete orbit-times-label product is fixed by all complex automorphisms, hence is a nonzero rational integer; repeated orbit values remain indexed. Constants c,A are fixed with K, NN before ell/closures/iota/Frobenius/families. Injective selection of labels and deletion of ell-adically integral factors gives the exact norm-product inequality. Empty families and ell=3 are included.

Compared all fields of literal CongruenceNumberRankThree: fixed quadratic K; e,N>=1; p>=7 prime avoiding N and discK; w above p; full finite Aut(C)-stable root-of-unity orbit; nonzero NN and logarithmic bound; all later original coefficient data and pairwise-nonisomorphic collections; original Adm3 or Adm2 at N*abs(discriminant). All are supplied. OneChar and unconditional PropGK remain separate.

primary_literature_inspected.locator: TheoremA; Shin-regular definition; Theorem1.1 and Corollary1.2
